summary: Broadridge Financial Solutions filed an 8-K reporting the entry into an underwriting agreement for a public offering of $500M 5.750% Senior Notes due 2036. The offering, underwritten by J.P. Morgan, BofA, Morgan Stanley, and Wells Fargo, was priced on May 4, 2026, with closing expected May 15, 2026, pursuant to an existing Form S-3. This is a routine shelf takedown of debt securities, not a special situation. No premium, board recommendation, or structural complexity is involved. Watch for standard closing conditions; no risk-arb opportunity exists.
